scenario: Before the quarterly AP close, scan the vendor list in QuickBooks for duplicate vendor records (same tax ID or near-identical names/addresses), merge them into the record with the most recent payment activity, and post a summary of the merged vendors to the #finance-ops Slack channel.
rule_hooks: tax ID match, survivorship by last payment date

scenario: Weekly, review the vendor compliance Google Sheet for certificates of insurance past their expiration date, set each affected vendor to 'On Hold' in the procurement tracker, and email the vendor contact a renewal request.
rule_hooks: COI expiry date, minimum coverage thresholds

scenario: At month end, find purchase orders in Xero that are still open more than 90 days after full receipt or with no activity, close them, and email each PO owner a list of what was closed.
rule_hooks: PO age, receipt status, inactivity cutoff

scenario: After a supplier catalog import, scan the inventory Google Sheet for SKUs whose descriptions break the naming convention (unit-of-measure order, abbreviations, casing), rewrite them to the standard format, and log every change on a separate audit tab.
rule_hooks: SKU naming convention, UoM abbreviation table

scenario: Each quarter, compare actual 90-day consumption in the inventory sheet to each item's stored reorder point and safety stock, update the items whose values deviate more than 25%, and send the changed list to the warehouse lead in Slack.

Mark inventory items with no movement in 12 months and zero open orders as obsolete in the inventory system, move them to an 'Archived SKUs' sheet, and open an Asana task for finance to review write-offs.
rule_hooks: last movement date, open order check

scenario: Daily, cross-check backordered sales orders in the order tracker against supplier ETA updates from Gmail, update each order's expected ship date, and tag orders slipping past the customer promise date for CSM follow-up in HubSpot.

Scan open facilities requests in Freshdesk for duplicates reported by different employees about the same location and issue (e.g., 'HVAC 3rd floor east'), merge them into the oldest ticket, and notify the merged requesters.
rule_hooks: location + issue category match, oldest-ticket survivorship

scenario: After the facilities team introduced a new category taxonomy, re-tag all open and last-30-day Zendesk facilities tickets from the legacy categories to the new ones using the mapping sheet, and flag any that don't map cleanly.

Weekly, find recurring conference room bookings on Google Calendar whose organizer has left the company or that have had no attendees join for four consecutive weeks, cancel the remaining occurrences, and email the organizer's manager.
rule_hooks: employee roster status, no-show streak threshold

scenario: Monthly, compare licensed Zoom users against the HR roster in Google Sheets, downgrade accounts belonging to terminated employees or inactive for 60+ days to basic, and post the reclaimed seat count to #it-ops.
rule_hooks: HR termination status, last login cutoff

scenario: Ahead of a SaaS renewal, cross-reference the Slack workspace member list with the HR roster, deactivate accounts for departed staff and convert expired contractors to single-channel guests, and record each change in the IT access log sheet.

Reconcile the IT hardware asset register in Google Sheets against the latest MDM export emailed to IT, mark devices missing from MDM for 30+ days as 'Unaccounted', update assigned users from the export, and open Jira tickets for missing laptops.
rule_hooks: MDM last check-in, assignment source of truth

scenario: Scan the offboarding tracker for employees who left more than 14 days ago with equipment still listed as unreturned, set their recovery status to 'Escalated', and email each former employee's manager plus the shipping vendor a recovery request.
rule_hooks: days since termination, equipment return SLA

scenario: Quarterly, review the asset register for laptops and monitors whose warranty ends within 60 days, tag them 'Refresh Candidate', and create a consolidated procurement request in Monday.com for replacements.
rule_hooks: warranty end date, device age refresh policy

scenario: Scan the contract repository spreadsheet for vendor agreements with auto-renewal dates within the notice window, tag each as 'Renewal Decision Needed', and create Asana tasks assigned to the contract owners with the notice deadline.
rule_hooks: auto-renew notice period, contract owner field

scenario: Weekly, find DocuSign envelopes for vendor agreements that have sat unsigned for more than 30 days, void those superseded by a newer envelope to the same vendor, send reminders on the rest, and update the contract tracker status.
rule_hooks: envelope age, supersession by newer envelope

scenario: Scan vendor records updated in the last 30 days where remittance bank details changed but the 'callback verified' field is empty, set them to payment hold in QuickBooks, and email the AP team the list for phone verification.
rule_hooks: bank detail change log, callback verification policy

scenario: Before 1099 season, review all US vendors paid over $600 this year in QuickBooks, flag those missing a W-9 or TIN in the vendor compliance sheet, and send each a templated W-9 request from the AP Gmail account.
Annually, mark vendors with no bills or payments in 18 months and no active contracts as inactive in Xero, and post a list to the procurement Slack channel for objections before the cutoff.
rule_hooks: last transaction date, active contract lookup

scenario: Daily, scan unpaid supplier bills in QuickBooks, match them against the PO and receiving log in Google Sheets, mark matched bills approved for payment, and create exception tickets in Jira for price or quantity variances beyond tolerance.

Before each payment run, scan pending bills for duplicates (same vendor, amount, and invoice number or date within 7 days), void the duplicates in Xero, and notify the AP clerk in Slack with the evidence.

Weekly, review open purchase requests in the procurement Airtable base, auto-close those whose requester cancelled by email or that have been pending approval over 45 days, route the rest to the correct approver by spend tier, and notify requesters.
rule_hooks: approval matrix by spend tier, pending age cutoff

scenario: At month end, review the last month's purchase transactions in QuickBooks for expense categories that conflict with the vendor's default GL mapping (e.g., software coded as office supplies), recode them, and send the controller a change summary.

Weekly, find corporate card transactions in the expense sheet older than 10 days without an attached receipt, tag them 'Receipt Missing', send each cardholder a Slack DM listing their items, and suspend cards with more than five overdue.

After the monthly carrier invoice arrives in Gmail, reconcile each billed shipment against the shipment log, mark overcharged or duplicate lines as disputed in the freight tracker, and email the carrier rep a dispute list.
rule_hooks: contracted rate card, accessorial charge rules

scenario: Scan open orders in the order management sheet for malformed or non-standard shipping addresses (missing zip, state names spelled out, PO boxes for freight), correct them to the standard format, and put unfixable ones on hold with a note to the account owner in Salesforce.
rule_hooks: address format standard, carrier PO box restrictions

scenario: Daily, compare orders marked 'Shipped' in the order tracker with carrier tracking status, revert those with no carrier scan after 3 days to 'Pending Pickup', and alert the warehouse in Slack.
rule_hooks: carrier scan status, days without scan

scenario: Before ERP sync, scan Salesforce ship-to locations for duplicate addresses under the same account, merge them into the primary site, repoint open orders, and log merges in an audit sheet.
rule_hooks: normalized address match, primary site flag

scenario: Scan the preventive maintenance schedule in Google Sheets for equipment (HVAC units, forklifts, generators) whose last service date exceeds its maintenance interval, create overdue work orders in the facilities tool, and book vendor visits on the facilities calendar.

Monthly, compare the warehouse staff roster with the training completion sheet, flag employees whose forklift or OSHA certification has expired, mark them restricted on the shift schedule, and email their supervisors.

Review the compliance calendar sheet of business licenses, fire inspections, and elevator permits per site, update statuses from inspector emails in the compliance Gmail inbox, and create Asana renewal tasks for anything expiring within 90 days.
rule_hooks: permit expiry date, renewal lead time per type

scenario: Quarterly, reconcile the building badge access list against the HR roster and the contractor register, mark badges belonging to departed staff or expired contractors for deactivation, and send the list to the security vendor by email.

Scan the operations shared drive folders for vendor and contract files shared with external email domains no longer on the approved vendor list, remove that access, and report the revocations to the folder owners in Slack.

At the end of each quarter, find tasks on the IT and facilities Asana projects with no updates in 60 days or tied to completed projects, archive them or reassign those owned by departed staff to the team lead, and post a cleanup summary.

After the IT service catalog reorganization, re-tag open Jira service desk tickets with the new component and assignment group based on keywords and the old category, and alert the owning teams to their new queues.

Review recurring vendor check-in meetings on the ops team calendars, cancel series for vendors whose contracts have ended per the contract tracker, update attendee lists where vendor contacts changed, and notify the vendor contacts.
rule_hooks: contract end date, current vendor contact list

scenario: Scan supplier contacts in HubSpot for bounced emails, duplicate entries, and contacts at vendors marked inactive, merge duplicates, mark bounced contacts invalid, and archive contacts tied to inactive suppliers.
rule_hooks: email bounce status, vendor active flag

scenario: Clear the logistics shared Gmail inbox of freight quote threads older than 30 days, label those tied to a booked shipment with the shipment ID from the freight tracker, archive expired quotes, and log any unanswered quote requests in Slack.
rule_hooks: quote validity period, shipment booking match

scenario: After a warehouse cycle count is uploaded to Google Sheets, compare counted quantities to system on-hand by bin, post adjustments within tolerance automatically, and create a recount Asana task for variances beyond the threshold or above a dollar value.

Ahead of quarter-end, AP asks the agent to compare payment terms on every active vendor in QuickBooks against the terms in the signed contracts summary sheet in Google Sheets. It updates mismatched vendor records and posts a list of changed vendors to the #ap-ops Slack channel.

Procurement's annual review triggers a pass over the approved-supplier Google Sheet, using trailing-12-month spend from Xero and scorecard ratings. The agent promotes, demotes or flags each supplier's tier and emails category managers about demotions.

After a supplier sends a new contract price list in Gmail, the agent compares it with the item prices in the procurement catalog sheet. It corrects lines that are off by more than tolerance and marks discontinued items inactive.

Procurement adopted a new spend-category taxonomy, so the agent re-tags every vendor record in the vendor master and in HubSpot company records from old category codes to new ones using the mapping table. Ambiguous one-to-many mappings are routed to a review list.

Each month, the agent recomputes remaining balances on blanket POs in the PO tracker from invoices posted against them in QuickBooks. It corrects the balance column, flags POs above 90% consumption, and emails the PO owners.

Before year-end, the agent reviews every vendor's 1099 flag in QuickBooks against entity type on file and payment method (card payments excluded). It toggles incorrect flags and logs each change for the tax preparer.

After an RFQ deadline passes, the agent scans the sourcing inbox for supplier replies and updates the RFQ tracker sheet row by row (quoted, declined, no response). It sends a single reminder to non-responders still inside the grace period.

The agent processes a backlog of vendor 'we've moved' and remit-to-change emails in the AP inbox, updating remit addresses in Xero only where the sender domain matches the vendor's domain on file. It routes the others to a verification queue.

During month-end close, the agent finds vendor credit memos in Xero that are sitting unapplied. It applies each one to that vendor's oldest open bill when amounts and currency allow, and lists the rest for the AP lead.

Each week, the agent scans open bills in QuickBooks for vendors offering early-payment terms like 2/10 net 30. It tags bills still inside the discount window with a priority-pay label and their deadline, and removes stale tags from bills whose window has lapsed.

After a department reorg, the agent updates open purchase requisitions and recurring vendor bills that still reference retired cost centers, using finance's successor mapping sheet. Each requester is notified on Slack.

The agent reviews vendor onboarding tickets in Freshdesk that have been pending more than 21 days. It closes ones where the requester cancelled, nudges vendors with missing documents, and escalates the rest to the procurement manager.

After a run of receiving errors, the agent compares the purchase unit of measure on supplier catalog entries with the stocking unit on inventory records. It corrects conversion factors (case of 12 vs each) and flags open POs that were raised in the wrong unit.
rule_hooks: supplier pack-size data, UoM conversion table

scenario: Each week, the agent scans the lot-tracked inventory sheet for lots past their expiry date or within 30 days of it. It moves expired lots to the QUARANTINE location status, tags near-expiry lots for first-out picking, and alerts the warehouse lead.
After a warehouse re-layout, the agent updates bin location codes on every SKU record using the old-to-new bin map from facilities. It also lists SKUs whose old bin has no successor.

The agent reviews open RMAs in the Zendesk returns queue against the warehouse receiving log. It closes RMAs whose goods were received and inspected, triggers the credit note in QuickBooks, and sends a last-call email to customers past the 30-day ship-back window.

Product ops discontinued several components, so the agent scans kit/bundle BOMs for references to discontinued SKUs. It swaps in the approved substitutes from the substitution list and marks kits without a substitute as unsellable.
rule_hooks: component substitution list, discontinued SKU list

scenario: The agent finds drop-ship orders marked shipped that have no tracking number. It pulls tracking numbers from supplier shipment-confirmation emails in Gmail, fills them in, and lists orders with no confirmation after 5 business days.

An integration glitch double-posted web orders, so the agent finds duplicate sales orders (same customer, items and timestamp within minutes) and cancels the later copy unless it has already shipped. Affected account owners are told on Slack.

Using monthly customer usage reports from email, the agent reconciles consignment inventory held at customer sites. It updates on-hand quantities, raises invoices for consumed units, and flags sites whose variance is above tolerance.

For EHS compliance, the agent checks every hazardous-material SKU for a linked Safety Data Sheet in the shared drive revised within the last 3 years. It links any newer SDS it finds and emails suppliers requesting missing or outdated ones.
rule_hooks: SDS revision age rule, hazmat SKU flag

scenario: Before a customs broker audit, the agent fills missing HTS tariff codes and country-of-origin fields on export product records from the trade compliance classification sheet. Products with no classification are sent to the trade compliance lead.

After a floor move, the agent reconciles the assigned-desk sheet against the HR active roster. It frees desks held by departed or fully remote employees, fixes desk numbers that changed in the move, and emails the workplace team the newly available desks.

At the start of each quarter, the agent compares the parking permit register with the active employee list and the paid-permit payroll deductions. It revokes permits for departed staff, flags unpaid permits, and notifies the garage vendor of the plates to remove.

The agent scans the mailroom package log for parcels unclaimed more than 10 days. It sends final pickup reminders, marks parcels for departed employees as return-to-sender, and closes entries already signed for.

Facilities finance has a backlog of utility invoices in QuickBooks with no site assigned. The agent maps each one to a site and meter using the meter register, sets the site class, and flags invoices whose meter numbers aren't in the register.

The agent compares lease option, renewal-notice and escalation dates in the real estate tracker with reminder events on the facilities Google Calendar. It creates missing reminders at the policy lead time and deletes reminders for terminated leases.
rule_hooks: lease abstract dates, notice lead time

scenario: The agent reconciles the company vehicle register with DMV renewal notices and fuel-card mileage. It updates registration expiry dates and odometer readings, flags vehicles near registration lapse, and assigns overdue service tasks in Asana.
Per the privacy retention policy, the agent purges visitor management records older than 18 months, keeping only anonymized counts. Records tied to an open incident or legal hold are left in place.

The agent audits Google Groups email lists such as ops-all and site-leads against the HR roster and role assignments. It removes departed members, adds missing role-holders, and posts the change summary to the group owners.

Under the workspace hygiene policy, the agent finds Slack channels with no messages in 90 days. It posts a 7-day archive warning, then archives channels nobody objected to, skipping exempt ones such as announcement or compliance channels.

The agent reconciles the IT domain and SSL certificate inventory sheet with registrar and certificate-authority expiry emails. It updates expiry dates and owners, flags certificates expiring within 30 days, and opens renewal tickets in Jira.

The agent compares the carrier's monthly line report with the device assignment sheet and the HR roster. It suspends lines with no assigned or active employee, fixes reassigned numbers, and emails telecom vendor management the list of lines to cancel.

After a wave of departures, the agent finds open Asana tasks and projects owned by deactivated users. It reassigns each one to the person's manager or designated successor from the offboarding sheet and comments on the task with the handoff.

The agent reviews IT change requests in Jira that are still 'Scheduled' after their implementation window. It closes those with a completion note in the change log, marks the rest as missed, and notifies the change advisory board.
rule_hooks: change window dates, CAB closure criteria

scenario: The agent repairs facilities and IT on-call rotation events on Google Calendar that still list departed or on-leave staff. It swaps in the next eligible person per the rotation order and announces the changes in Slack.

At month-end, the agent reconciles staffing-agency contractor timesheets against each contractor's PO-approved hours. It flags overruns, holds invoices that exceed approved hours in QuickBooks, and emails the hiring managers.
rule_hooks: PO approved hours, bill rate card

scenario: Once the new holiday calendar is published, the agent scans the warehouse shift schedule for shifts on company holidays. It removes non-essential shifts, tags essential ones for holiday pay, and notifies affected staff.

The agent scans the operations shared drive for vendor contracts, POs and receiving documents past their retention period. It moves them to the archive folder or a destruction queue per the schedule, skipping documents under legal hold.
rule_hooks: records retention schedule, legal hold list

scenario: After the government denied-party list is updated, the agent re-screens all active vendors and ship-to customers against it. It flags potential matches, places their open orders and POs on compliance hold, and notifies trade compliance.
